title: Al-A'la 87:11-15 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-A'la, At-Tariq 1 to 8 and waqf
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-A'la 87:11-15 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 23. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى (١١) ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ (١٢) ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ (١٣) قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ (١٤) وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ (١٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: But the wretched one will avoid it -
[He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-A'la 87:11-15 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 87:11-15 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 87:11-15 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Read the passage 87:11 to 15 from the mushaf page itself, not the slide.
questions.a: Pupil reads from the mushaf with the rules applied.

questions.q: Name the three things in 87:14 to 15 that bring success.
questions.a: Purifying oneself, mentioning the name of one's Lord, and praying.

questions.q: 87:14 says success belongs to the one who ...
questions.a: A) purifies himself. 87:14: 'He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself.'

questions.q: Think again: 'He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself, mentions the name of his Lord and prays' (87:14 to 15). What does success mean to you?
questions.a: Real success is with Allah: a clean heart, remembering Allah and praying, not just money or fame.
